**Finding: Compliant** — no edit proposed.

The agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-inducement restriction on Bluefly:

- **§ 14.8 (Personnel)** — the expected home for such a covenant — covers only supervision/direction of each party's own personnel, IBM's right to assign its people, and IBM's subcontracting rights. No hiring restriction.
- **§ 14.16 (Freedom of Action)** confirms each party is free to enter similar agreements with others, with no personnel carve-out.
- Targeted searches for "solicit", "hire", "recruit", "induce" and "employ" surface nothing beyond definitional and indemnity references to employees.

This lands on our preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so there is nothing to narrow — no duration, scope, or general-advertising carve-out analysis is needed. We should simply monitor any SOW or order-level terms for a re-introduced solicitation restriction; if one appears, the fallback (mutual, 12 months, personnel directly involved, advertising/unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire) would apply.
